title: 第23章 夜闯破宅暗中出手第24章 当场质问粮价飞涨
content_zh:
;;
林青将肩上的沉重米袋放在地上，目光平静地看向那赵癞痢。
本来还吵吵嚷嚷的赵癞痢，忽然被门口一团高大阴影罩住。
那影子只是站在那里，也不说话，却让赵癞痢感觉心头一窒。
赵癞痢回头，只见到身材高大的林青，站立原地，虬结健壮的双臂，裸露在外。
尤其是那双亮得吓人的眼眸，更让人望而生畏。
赵癞痢不由得心内一颤。
但他似是想起什么，随即梗着脖子道：“林少东家，你回来的正好。你姐姐卖药缺斤短两，这事你看怎么办吧！”
林婉见到弟弟，像是找到了主心骨，急声道：“阿青，我没有，我称得清清楚楚。”
林青对姐姐投去一个安抚的眼神，神色变得温和下来。
他对赵癞痢拱了拱手：“原来是赵大叔。许是家姐一时疏忽，看错了秤砣。小事一桩，何必动气？”
如此温和的话语，顿时让找茬的赵癞痢一愣。
颇有种拳头打向棉花的感觉。
“那你打算怎么处理？”
赵癞痢下意识询问。
林青转身，进了药铺，从柜子里取出一包分量十足的止血散，塞到赵癞痢手里。
他语气温和道：“这包药材，算是我济世堂赔给您的，分量只多不少。您看，这样可行？”
赵癞痢没想到，这林青如此好说话。
他张了张嘴，终究还是没再说话。
赵癞痢接过药材掂量了一下，确实分量十足。

脸上顿时露出得意的神色，哼哼道：“这还差不多，算你小子识相。”
说罢，生怕林青反悔似的。
揣好药材，扒开人群，一溜烟走了。
围观的街坊见没热闹可看。
也渐渐散去，只觉无趣。
回到铺子内，林婉兀自气愤难平，眼圈微红：“阿青，你为何要让着他？那赵癞痢是街上有名的泼皮无赖，惯会讹人，明明是他胡搅蛮缠。”
林青关上店门，神色平静，给姐姐倒了杯水：
“姐，我知道。跟这种人纠缠，赢了道理，输了时间和心情，还影响铺子声誉。”
“一副不值钱的止血草，打发走了清净。”
林婉仍是不忿：“可是这也太憋屈了，而且我听说，这赵癞痢前阵子得罪了黑泥帮的人，欠了赌债，黑泥帮的人最近常来找他麻烦。”
“他自己一身骚，还敢来惹我们！”
林青目光微闪，黑泥帮？
这么说的话，那他可得给赵癞痢提上日程了。
林青点了点头，并未多说什么。
只是安慰姐姐：“恶人自有恶人磨，姐你别往心里去。”
……

Lin Qing placed the heavy rice bag on his shoulder on the ground and looked at Zhao Ledia calmly.
Zhao Diao, who was still noisy at first, was suddenly covered by a tall shadow at the door.
The shadow just stood there and said nothing, but it made Zhao Diao feel suffocated.
Zhao Lili turned around and saw the tall Lin Qing, standing on the same spot, with his strong arms exposed.
Especially those frighteningly bright eyes are even more intimidating.
Zhao Lili couldn't help but feel a tremor in his heart.
But he seemed to remember something, and then he frowned and said: "Lin Shaodong's family, you came back just in time. Your sister is short of money in selling medicine, what should you do with this matter?"
When Lin Wan saw her younger brother, she seemed to have found a backbone, and said anxiously: "Aqing, I don't have one, I can tell you clearly."
Lin Qing cast a comforting look at her sister and her expression softened.
He bowed his hand to Zhao Lili: "It turned out to be Uncle Zhao. Xu Shi's sister was negligent and misjudged the weight. It's such a trivial matter, why get angry?"
Such gentle words immediately stunned Zhao Bili, who was looking for trouble.
It feels like a fist hitting cotton.
"Then what are you going to do about it?"
Zhao Lili asked subconsciously.
Lin Qing turned around, entered the drug store, took out a generous pack of hemostatic powder from the cabinet, and stuffed it into Zhao Lili's hand.
He said in a gentle tone: "This pack of medicinal materials is what I, Jishitang, compensated for you, and the weight is just a little more. Do you think this is feasible?"
Zhao Lili didn't expect that Lin Qing was so easy to talk to.
He opened his mouth, but in the end he said no more.
Zhao Lili took the medicinal materials and weighed them, and found that they were indeed quite heavy.
A proud look suddenly appeared on his face, and he hummed: "That's pretty much it. You're a wise boy."
Having said that, she was afraid that Lin Qing would regret it.
He gathered the medicinal materials, pushed through the crowd, and left in a hurry.
The onlookers saw no excitement.
It also gradually dispersed, and I just felt boring.
Back in the shop, Lin Wan was furious and her eyes were slightly red: "Ah Qing, why did you let him go? That Zhao Leli is a well-known scoundrel on the street and is good at blackmailing people. He is obviously the one causing trouble."
Lin Qing closed the store door, looked calm, and poured a glass of water for her sister:
"Sister, I know. If you get entangled with this kind of person, you will lose your reason, but you will lose your time and mood, and it will also affect the reputation of the shop."
"A worthless piece of styptic grass has sent away the purity."
Lin Wan was still unhappy: "But this is too frustrating. Moreover, I heard that Zhao Diaoliang offended people from the Black Ni Gang a while ago and owed gambling debts. People from the Black Ni Gang have often come to trouble him recently."
"He himself is so sexy, yet he dares to mess with us!"
Lin Qing's eyes flashed slightly, Black Mud Gang?
If he said that, then he would have to put it on Zhao Diarrhea's agenda.
Lin Qing nodded and said nothing more.
I just comforted my sister: "Evil people will be punished by evil people. Sister, don't take it personally."
